title: Threadkeeper browser verification round-43: 156.0.8078.4
requirement: Verify the remaining fused-window repairs and the requested compact chat/sidebar layout against an isolated real browser.

requirements.text: The fused window opens directly on Threads, keeps navigation and layering usable, accepts the first click after the palette closes, and recovers when Paperclip restarts.
Move Summary / Live / Split next to the thread title, fit the thread controls into one row, and give the live chat more space.
Merge thread search, filters, sort, grouping and selection into the existing Sessions sidebar.
Format Ask as a readable multiline question field with its action below in the sidebar.
